The '''DS-11 Starforged sniper rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Similar to the [[DS-8 Starforged sniper rifle]] and [[DS-9 Starforged sniper rifle]], it featured a longer barrel and additional components on its stock.

==Behind the scenes==
The DS-11 Starforged sniper rifle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Master's Shadow Pack.
